response.justification: Bogdan is a strong, versatile senior full-stack/web engineer with broad language exposure, but his profile shows no evidence of Japanese language proficiency, no Linux kernel development experience, and no background in embedded/networking security technologies (MACsec, 802.1X, NETCONF, SNMP, switch chips). His C/C++ experience is limited to a brief 2014-2015 stint and a university project, far short of the deep UNIX/C and kernel-level work required for this role.
strengths: Extensive, diverse senior-level software engineering experience across many stacks
Demonstrated ability to quickly ramp up on new technologies and take ownership of projects
Experience with Linux systems, Docker, CI/CD, and infrastructure tooling
concerns: No mention of Japanese language skills, a hard native-level requirement for this role
No demonstrated Linux kernel investigation or source-code modification experience
No background in embedded networking security domains (MACsec, 802.1X, switch chips, NETCONF/SNMP)

key_factors.factor: No Linux kernel or embedded security domain experience
